chapters.title: Foundations & Perspectives in Psychology
chapters.description: Explore the scientific roots of psychology, classic schools of thought, modern frameworks, and rigorous research methods.

chapters.title: Biological Bases of Behavior & the Brain
chapters.description: Investigate neural communication, neurotransmitters, brain structures, hemispheric functions, and endocrine regulation.

chapters.title: Sensation, Perception & Consciousness
chapters.description: Understand how physical stimuli become mental representations, perceptual organization principles, sleep cycles, and altered states.

chapters.title: Learning, Conditioning & Behavior
chapters.description: Master classical Pavlovian conditioning, Skinnerian operant conditioning, schedules of reinforcement, and social modeling.

chapters.title: Cognition, Memory & Intelligence
chapters.description: Analyze memory encoding and retrieval, causes of forgetting, problem-solving heuristics, cognitive biases, and IQ models.

chapters.title: Lifespan Human Development
chapters.description: Trace human growth across cognitive, physical, and socioemotional domains from prenatal infancy through aging.

chapters.title: Social Psychology & Personality
chapters.description: Examine how social contexts shape behavior through conformity and attribution, and explore classic and modern personality theories.

chapters.title: Psychological Disorders & Treatment
chapters.description: Examine the classification and etiology of major mental disorders and explore evidence-based psychotherapeutic and biological treatments.
